description: This is a unit test class for ImmutableFeatureProperties, testing equality, immutability, JSON serialization, and validation of property keys within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.things package.

classes.name: ImmutableFeaturePropertiesTest
classes.description: A final JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of ImmutableFeatureProperties, including equality, immutability, JSON correctness, and key validation.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode() and equals() methods for ImmutableFeatureProperties using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableFeatureProperties instances are immutable, including nested JsonObject instances.

methods.name: createInstanceReturnsTheExpectedJson
methods.description: Confirms that an empty ImmutableFeatureProperties instance serializes to an empty JSON object.

methods.name: ensureFeaturesToBuilderWorks
methods.description: Ensures that the toBuilder() method on Feature objects returns a builder that reproduces the original instance.

methods.name: createInvalidPropertyKey
methods.description: Tests that setting a property with an invalid key (containing a slash) throws JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: createInvalidNestedPropertyKey
methods.description: Tests that setting a nested JsonObject with an invalid key throws JsonKeyInvalidException.

methods.name: createInvalidNestedNestedPropertyKey
methods.description: Tests nested JsonObjects with invalid keys to ensure exceptions are thrown.

methods.name: createTooLargePropertyKey
methods.description: Tests that property keys exceeding the maximum allowed length result in JsonKeyInvalidException.
